title: PAR2PLAY Booking Record - Field Mapping Reference
description: Canonical field mapping for booking creation and updates. Use this as the single source of truth for all booking field definitions, types, sources, validation rules, and example values.

fields.description: Unique identifier for the booking record. Auto-generated using year, guest first name, and sequence number.
fields.validation: Must start with 'book_', followed by 4-digit year, guest name, and numeric sequence. Must be unique in par2play_booking.json.

fields.description: The unique identifier for the PAR2PLAY business entity. Fixed value for all PAR2PLAY bookings.
fields.validation: Always use 'b_8f3a2e10-4c21-4b7a-9d2e-1a2b3c4d5e6f' for PAR2PLAY.

fields.description: The location identifier for the PAR2PLAY Somerset venue. Fixed value for all Somerset bookings.
fields.validation: Always use 'd1e2f3a4-b5c6-4d7e-8f9a-0b1c2d3e4f5a' for PAR2PLAY Somerset.

fields.description: Reference to the specific time slot (bay rental) or resource slot being booked. Retrieved from available ppslot records.
fields.validation: Must exactly match an available ppslot.id with isAvailable=true and no conflicting bookings.

fields.description: The name of the guest making the booking. For existing customers, use their stored name. For new customers, capture during conversation.
fields.validation: Non-empty string, max 255 characters. Should include at least first name.

fields.source: From ppcustomer.id or null if new customer
fields.description: Reference to the customer profile if booking belongs to an existing customer. Can be null for guest bookings or new customers (to be created after first booking).
fields.validation: If provided, must match an existing ppcustomer.id. If null, treat as guest booking.

fields.description: Confidence score indicating how certain we are that the identified customer is correct. 100 = phone number matched exactly. Lower values = fuzzy match or partial information.
fields.validation: Must be between 0 and 100. Use 100 for phone-number-verified customers.

fields.format: Enum: PhoneNumberMatch | NameMatch | EmailMatch | ManualEntry | Guest
fields.description: Method used to identify or verify the customer. PhoneNumberMatch indicates phone-based lookup. Guest indicates no customer record.
fields.validation: Must be one of the predefined enum values.

fields.description: Status of the customer identification. Confirmed = verified match. Pending = awaiting confirmation. Unverified = uncertain match.
fields.validation: For phone-agent bookings, always use 'Confirmed' once customer approves the booking.

fields.description: Human-readable name of the service being booked (e.g., 'Bay Rental', 'Lesson', 'Group Event').
fields.validation: Non-empty string, max 255 characters. Must match ppslot.serviceNameRaw.

fields.description: Reference to the ppservice record defining the service (bay rental, lesson, etc.). Used for pricing, capacity, and fulfillment rules.
fields.validation: Must match an existing ppservice.id.

fields.description: Human-readable name of the resource (bay) or provider (instructor) assigned to this booking.
fields.validation: Non-empty string, max 255 characters. Should be the display name of the resource or provider.

fields.description: Reference to the physical resource (golf bay) assigned to this booking. Links to ppslot.resourceId.
fields.validation: Must match an existing ppslot.resourceId.

fields.source: From ppstaff or ppservice if lesson booking, null otherwise
fields.description: Reference to a provider (instructor, trainer) if applicable. Null for bay-only bookings. Used for lesson bookings with assigned instructors.
fields.validation: If provided, must match an existing ppstaff.id. Leave null for non-lesson services.

fields.format: Enum: CreditCard | MembershipBenefit | PackageCredit | Cash | Invoice
fields.description: How the booking was paid for. CreditCard = direct card charge. MembershipBenefit = membership discount applied. PackageCredit = pre-purchased package credits used.
fields.validation: Must be one of the predefined enum values. Ask caller explicitly which method to use.

fields.source: From ppmembership.id if membership discount applied, null otherwise
fields.description: Reference to the specific membership instance used to pay for or discount this booking. Null if no membership applied.
fields.validation: If provided, must match an active ppmembership.id belonging to the customer with valid endDate.

fields.source: From pppackage.id if package credits applied, null otherwise
fields.description: Reference to the customer package (pre-purchased credits) used to pay for this booking. Null if no package credits applied.
fields.validation: If provided, must match an active pppackage.id with creditsRemaining > 0.

fields.description: Number of package credits deducted from the customer's account for this booking. 0 if no package used.
fields.validation: Must be >= 0 and <= customer's remaining credits in customerPackageIdUsed.

fields.source: From ppslot.price (adjusted for membership discount if applicable)
fields.description: Amount charged to the customer for this booking, in USD. If membership discount applied, this is the discounted price. If package used, this may be 0.
fields.validation: Must be >= 0. Should reflect ppslot.price minus any membership discount.

fields.description: Reference to the generated invoice for this booking, if applicable. Null until invoice is generated.
fields.validation: Can be null until booking is invoiced. Once assigned, must be unique across all bookings.

fields.source: Current date when booking is created
fields.description: The calendar date on which the booking was made (when the customer called or booked). Different from appointmentDate.
fields.validation: Must be a valid ISO 8601 date. Should be today's date when creating the booking.

fields.source: From ppslot.date (the date of the slot)
fields.description: The calendar date of the actual appointment/slot (when the customer will use the bay or lesson). May be days or weeks after bookedDate.
fields.validation: Must be a valid ISO 8601 date. Must match ppslot.date. Should be >= today.

fields.format: ISO 8601 time (HH:MM:SS) or HH:MM in 24-hour format
fields.description: The start time of the booked slot on appointmentDate. PAR2PLAY hours are 10:00-22:00.
fields.validation: Must be a valid time in HH:MM:SS format. Should be between 10:00 and 22:00 (venue hours).

fields.format: ISO 8601 time (HH:MM:SS) or HH:MM in 24-hour format
fields.description: The end time of the booked slot on appointmentDate. Typically 1 hour after startTime for standard bay bookings.
fields.validation: Must be a valid time in HH:MM:SS format. Must be > startTime. Should not exceed 22:00 (venue closing).

fields.format: Enum: Confirmed | Pending | Open | Cancelled | NoShow | Completed
fields.description: Current status of the booking. Confirmed = customer approved and payment confirmed. Cancelled = customer cancellation.
fields.validation: For new phone-agent bookings, set to 'Confirmed'. Can transition to Cancelled, Completed, or NoShow later.

fields.source: Set based on how booking was created
fields.format: Enum: PhoneAgent | Web | Mobile | InPerson | Admin
fields.description: Channel through which the booking was made. PhoneAgent indicates this was created by the voice AI agent.
fields.validation: For this agent, always set to 'PhoneAgent'.

fields.source: Current timestamp when booking is created
fields.description: Exact moment the booking record was created, including timezone information.
fields.validation: Must be a valid ISO 8601 timestamp. Should be the current time when the booking is saved.

fields.source: Current timestamp when booking is created or modified
fields.description: Exact moment of the last modification to the booking record. Initially same as createdAt.
fields.validation: Must be a valid ISO 8601 timestamp. Updated whenever the record is modified.

fields.description: The data model type identifier for this record. Used by the system to categorize and route the document.
fields.validation: Must always be 'ppbooking' for booking records.

notes.phone_agent_guidelines: When creating bookings via phone, always use this schema as reference. Validate every field before sending to data MCP.
notes.booking_creation_flow: 1. Fetch ppslot record → 2. Fetch customer (if exists) → 3. Build booking JSON using this schema → 4. Validate all required fields → 5. Create data record → 6. Confirm to caller
notes.field_priority: Focus on getting: slotId, customerId, appointmentDate, startTime, endTime, amountCharged correct. These are the core booking identifiers.
notes.timestamps: Always use current ISO 8601 format with timezone (e.g., 2026-01-15T10:30:45Z). Both createdAt and updatedAt should match at creation time.
notes.customerId_handling: For existing customers found via phone lookup: use their customerId. For new customers: leave null initially, create customer record after first booking.
notes.payment_method_selection: Ask caller explicitly. Options: CreditCard (default), MembershipBenefit (if active), PackageCredit (if active). Set amountCharged accordingly after discount.
